scenes.say: Did you know thyroid problems can affect your eyes? Here are three signs to watch for.

scenes.en: The immune system can cause swelling in the muscles and tissue behind the eye.
scenes.say: Why? The body's immune system can cause swelling in the muscles and tissue behind the eye.

scenes.en: Redness, watering or a sandy feeling that doesn't settle.
scenes.say: Sign one: dry, gritty, red or watery eyes that don't settle.

scenes.en: Eyes bulge, or the upper lid pulls back for a staring look.
scenes.say: Sign two: your eyes look bigger or bulging, or the upper eyelid pulls back, giving a staring look.

scenes.en: Seeing two of things, or pain when moving the eyes.
scenes.say: Sign three: double vision, or pain when you move your eyes.

scenes.en: It's more common in women and smokers, and can happen even when thyroid levels are controlled.
scenes.say: Did you know? It's more common in women, and smoking makes it worse. It can happen even when your thyroid levels are under control.

scenes.en: Vision drops, colours look faded, or double vision starts suddenly.
scenes.ta: பார்வை குறைந்தால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if your vision drops, colours look faded, or double vision starts suddenly.

scenes.en: Don't smoke. Wear sunglasses outdoors. Tell your doctor about eye changes.
scenes.say: If you have a thyroid condition, don't smoke, wear sunglasses outdoors, and tell your doctor about any eye changes. Book an eye test today.
